law: These are M5-prime Epii developmental capacities upon M0-M5, not a generic model catalogue. Native O:I products may embody model, harness, compute, Agency, Run and evidence mechanics; the target-specific developmental reason comes from the Epii-on-X source.
standing_law: active-operational-capacity-spec is current authored domain/design standing; implementation and observed-result standing must be evidenced independently.

capacities.name: Anuttara
capacities.developmental_law: language development by deliberate construction, articulation, formalisation, developer conversation, agentic mediation and etymological archaeology; explicitly not gradient training

capacities.name: Paramasiva
capacities.developmental_law: foundational-derivational CPT plus RAG; model is an articulating voice of the matheme while executable/canonical QL remains authority

capacities.name: Parashakti
capacities.developmental_law: graph-relational learning over derived embedding/representation geometry; learned representations remain rebuildable and never canonical graph authority

capacities.name: Mahamaya
capacities.developmental_law: canonical symbolic/calculation substrate remains constructed; calculation pathways may be learned through process-reward RL, federated and symbolic-genetic work; the training pipeline remains governed construction

capacities.name: Nara
capacities.developmental_law: Anima-led narrow QLoRA over personal/anima-Vak dialogic voice with optional DPO; slow, consent-gated voice tuning; identity, quaternionic state and canonical branch laws remain outside tuning

capacities.name: Epii
capacities.developmental_law: recursive synthetic-telic self-development of pedagogy, review, canon and autoresearch; CPT/RAG may support voice/reach but promotion remains deliberate human-in-the-loop Return
